topic: What is the ultimate statistical invariance of turbulence?
key_answer: No single measured statistic, exponent, or probability-density collapse is established as an unconditional invariant of all turbulence. Exact governing-equation symmetries and exact conditional relations, including the Kolmogorov four-fifths relation in its stated setting, must be separated from conditional similarity and intermittency- or regime-dependent behavior. CURA-Turb makes that separation testable through claim dossiers, regime cards, estimator audits, and conditional status labels.
known_risks: Publisher or DOI landing-page review remains required for seven background or discovery-stage references before external publication.
CURA-Turb requires turbulence-theory, numerical-analysis, statistics/uncertainty-quantification, experimental-metrology, and domain-flow review before implementation or engineering transfer.
No DNS calculation, laboratory measurement, facility operation, or engineering-flow experiment was executed; all proposed classification outcomes remain conditional.
